name: Tiaret

queries.query: Tiaret Algeria official cadastral parcel map GIS API cadastre land survey
queries.result: Search identified Algeria's official land-survey/land-registry institutional domain (DGDN) and the official ASAL geoportal, plus an official InfoGéolAlgérie map viewer. No public Tiaret parcel viewer, parcel service, or anonymous parcel API was exposed. The official references establish general institutional responsibility, not a city-specific public parcel endpoint.

queries.query: تيارت الجزائر مسح الأراضي والحفظ العقاري خريطة قطع الأراضي نظام معلومات جغرافي رسمي
queries.result: البحث العربي وجد إشارات إلى مديرية مسح الأراضي والحفظ العقاري لولاية تيارت وإلى مهام مصالح مسح الأراضي والحفظ العقاري، لكنه لم يجد عارضاً عاماً لقطع الأراضي أو واجهة API مجهولة يمكن استخدامها بأمان. النتائج المؤسسية العامة لا تثبت خدمة محلية مفتوحة للمدينة.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP GET succeeded anonymously. The response exposed the portal URL and token-service URL, but no token was requested because no login or private-token workflow is in scope.

attemptedRoutes.route: Official ASAL ArcGIS portal cadastral search
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP GET succeeded anonymously and returned total=0. This is only evidence that this bounded portal search returned no matching public items; it is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

Anonymous HTTP GET timed out after 20 seconds. The public result describes an ESRI WebADF 10.0.0.0 map at 1:200,000 with administrative/wilaya/commune and thematic layers, not a confirmed parcel layer. No retry with credentials, bypass, or TLS relaxation was made.

Search result identifies the official DGDN document as describing establishment of the general cadastre and land-register framework. It is general national agency/legal evidence, not a Tiaret parcel data response.

Search result locates a Tiaret office named مديرية مسح الأراضي, supporting existence of a local land-survey office. The page is not a first-party parcel service and supplied no machine-readable parcel schema or geometry; it is not treated as registry integration evidence.

sourceAssessment.localRegistryCustodian: Direction/office of land survey and land conservation for Tiaret (مديرية مسح الأراضي والحفظ العقاري لولاية تيارت) is evidenced by local institutional references, but no first-party public parcel endpoint was found.
sourceAssessment.nationalGeneralAgency: Algeria's DGDN/land-survey and land-conservation framework and the ASAL/ASGA government geospatial portals were identified as national/general sources; neither yielded an anonymous Tiaret parcel layer in this attempt.
fieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if later exposed

runtimeReadiness.reason: No independently qualified public parcel adapter or bounded parcel ID-plus-geometry response was evidenced. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.

uncertainty: The local Tiaret land-survey/land-conservation office may provide cadastral records through an in-person, request, procurement, or restricted workflow that is not exposed anonymously on the public web.
The ASAL portal search returned zero matching public items and the ASGA viewer timed out; neither result establishes citywide presence or absence of cadastral parcels.
No parcel geometry is retained because no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was obtained.
No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner/address/titleholder/tax fields, or TLS certificate exception was used.
